title: 第十九章 油锅取匙第二十章 江湖手段
content_zh:
听到了宋风这么说，知道了宋风要表演什么节目之后，赵总则是表现的非常的热切，甚至基本上让宋风把所需要的东西都列出来他去准备。
赵总忙忙碌碌的走了。
老二又跟着那几个老头子一起去训练，一起去为接下来的活动做准备了。
一时间，宋风跟自家大徒弟宋诚两个人却是突然安静了下来，毕竟现如今的情况下来看，在材料没准备好之前两人还真没什么事情。
想到了这里，宋风则是将目光看向了面前的大徒弟，随即背着手，带着大徒弟便向着屋顶上走去:
“老大，跟贫道来一趟……”
听到了宋风如此说，老大宋诚是连忙小跑跟上，两个人顺着楼梯趁着上方道路打开的时候走上了屋顶。
这酒店待遇确实是不错。
这个年代高楼大厦确实是环境一般，但站在高处，空气还是相对来说比较新鲜的。
来到顶层上，宋风看着底下的刚开始有些繁华的车水马龙，双眼之中带着一丝丝的熟悉，随即对着宋诚开口说道:
“今日你师弟他们一起去排练，你便在这里好好的修行吐纳之术，跟着贫道一起做。”
说到最后的时候，宋风则是让宋诚靠过来先是与他一起同调呼吸，随后让老大伸手捂住他的胸口感受着他的呼吸变化。
一深一浅，长短变化。
现如今老大虽然说暂时跟不上他的路子，但是却也是最有希望能修成的，就这样两个人一直在那里修行了一整天。
夜晚，宋风特地借着酒店里面的锅灶，特地为老大熬了一碗汤药，润肺止咳的，也免得真的伤了肺腑。
一直到第二日早晨。
等到花了很大时间将东西都备齐的赵总则是带着宋风，来到了一个空荡荡的房间之中。
仔细看去，只看到这房间里则是放着一个已经架好的大锅，里面按照宋风所想所说的放进去了半锅油。
虽然下面还没有放柴火。
但是这般场景就已经够唬人了。

寻常家里做饭的时候都害怕被油崩到，更别说这样一大锅油了。
“道长您先忙着，有什么需要的材料尽管说，只要节目效果不错就可以了。”
说到这里的时候，赵总则是转身离去不在这里继续观看，有锅有油了，接下来就得离远点避避嫌。
甭管什么节目，这都是人家吃饭的家伙，这其中肯定也有些什么机关之类的，万一自己在这里，那岂不是撞破了人家的吃饭的家伙事？
这可就不太好了。
听到了赵总如此说，宋风则是摇了摇头示意赵总跟上来，随后让老大点起了底下的那一大团干柴:
“既然是讲节目，那自然要提前把各种各样的意外先排除掉，做了就要做好，总不可能丢人现眼。”
“今日贫道且先演练一番，若是赵总觉得可以那就报上去，若是不可以咱们再商量别的东西。”
看着老大宋诚直接三两下就点起了火，火焰噼里啪啦燃烧，甚至看起来那半锅的油开始缓缓的有着热气升腾，赵总直接就有些懵了。
“不是……道长，这个锅，难道不需要提前做点手脚或者用一些秘法吗？”
说到秘法的时候，赵总则是着重的提醒了一下，毕竟油锅取匙这玩意儿看起来很危险，实际上更危险。
虽然大部分看戏的人都感觉有意思，甚至不太敢上去尝试，但是总觉得里面会有点技巧的。
现如今这锅可都是他们准备的。
更重要的是，包括柴火什么之类的可都是实打实摆在这儿的，所有东西都是经过他的眼的是没有提前准备的。
content_en:
After hearing what Song Feng said and knowing what show Song Feng was going to perform, Mr. Zhao was very enthusiastic and even basically asked Song Feng to list everything he needed to prepare.
Mr. Zhao left in a hurry.
The second child went to training with the old men again and prepared for the next activities together.
For a moment, Song Feng and his eldest disciple Song Cheng suddenly became quiet. After all, judging from the current situation, they really had nothing to do before the materials were prepared.
Thinking of this, Song Feng looked at the eldest disciple in front of him, then put his hands behind his back and led the eldest disciple towards the roof:
"Boss, come with Pindao..."
After hearing what Song Feng said, the boss Song Cheng hurriedly trotted to follow. The two of them followed the stairs and took advantage of the opening of the road above to get onto the roof.
The treatment at this hotel is really good.
High-rise buildings in this era do have a mediocre environment, but standing high up, the air is relatively fresh.
Arriving on the top floor, Song Feng looked at the bustling traffic below, with a hint of familiarity in his eyes, and then said to Song Cheng:
"Today, your junior brother and the others are going to rehearse together, so you can practice the art of breathing and breathing well here, and do it with Pindao."
At the end of the story, Song Feng asked Song Cheng to come closer and breathe in sync with him first, and then asked the boss to reach out and cover his chest to feel the changes in his breathing.
One is deep and one is shallow, the length changes.
Now, although the boss said that he could not follow his path for the time being, he was also the one with the best hope of succeeding. In this way, the two of them had been practicing there all day long.
At night, Song Feng used the stove in the hotel to make a bowl of soup for his boss to moisten his lungs and relieve his cough, so as not to really hurt his lungs.
Until the next morning.
After Mr. Zhao spent a lot of time getting everything ready, he took Song Feng to an empty room.
Looking carefully, he only saw a large pot that had been set up in the room, with half a pot of oil put in it as Song Feng had said.
Although there is no firewood down there yet.
But this scene is enough to scare people.
Usually when cooking at home, we are afraid of being burned by oil, let alone such a large pot of oil.
"Taoist Master, please be busy first. If you have any materials you need, just ask. As long as the program is effective, it will be fine."
When he said this, Mr. Zhao turned around and left without continuing to watch. There was oil in the pot, and he had to stay away to avoid suspicion.
No matter what the show is, these are people who eat, and there must be some kind of mechanism among them. If I were here, wouldn't it mean that someone else's food was broken?
This is not good.
After hearing what Mr. Zhao said, Song Feng shook his head and motioned for Mr. Zhao to follow him, and then asked the boss to light up the large ball of dry firewood at the bottom:
"Since it's a show, it's natural to eliminate all kinds of accidents in advance. If you do it, you have to do it well. You can't be embarrassed."
"I'm going to do some practice today. If Mr. Zhao thinks it's ok, then report it to him. If it's not ok, let's discuss something else."
Seeing the boss Song Cheng lighting the fire in a few clicks, the flames crackling and burning, and it even seemed that the half-pot of oil began to slowly heat up, Mr. Zhao was immediately confused.
"No... Taoist Master, doesn't this pot need to be done in advance or use some secret methods?"
When talking about the secret method, Mr. Zhao emphatically reminded him that after all, taking the spoon out of the oil pan looks dangerous, but it is actually more dangerous.
Although most people watching the show find it interesting and don't even dare to try it, they always feel that there is some skill involved.
Now this pot is all prepared by them.
What's more important, including firewood and the like, are all placed here. Everything passed through his eyes and was not prepared in advance.
